decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0010-kit-ab, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's four OS 1.74 port sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release. Its keep2 sites, which keep a stock opcode word, are written as the equivalent authored instructions: the two jsr sites as jsr sites (opcode 4eb9), the two pea sites (opcode 4879) as bytes sites with the address relocated to kit_ab_kab_msg.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc keeps its path relative to the source, so the .include line in src/kit-ab.s is unchanged.
